question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared localization-core and localized command-metadata contract as a core foundation, and sponsor the proposed five-PR landing sequence?
rationale: The change introduces a new package-wide product architecture and a gateway command-catalog field across core, UI, docs, scripts, native checks, and channels; patch review cannot determine whether that permanent ownership and API direction is desired.

options.title: Sponsor a staged foundation series
options.body: Approve the architecture direction, require exclusive rebased bundle diffs and contract/proof review, then land the series in its declared dependency order.

options.title: Narrow the core contract
options.body: Keep only a smaller localized presentation seam in core and route broader inventory, readiness, and surface-specific policy to their owning areas.

options.title: Pause the localization foundation
options.body: Do not add the shared core package or command-metadata contract until a maintainer-backed localization roadmap exists.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a staged foundation series
recommendation.body: Approve the architecture direction, require exclusive rebased bundle diffs and contract/proof review, then land the series in its declared dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: The author is the evidenced coordinator of the RFC-linked five-part proposal; a current-main localization or gateway/protocol owner should be added before a final decision.
